metadata.title: SSPP - COBO L1 Managed Endpoint
metadata.remarks: Normative System Security Plan Profile defining the baseline security, governance, and trust requirements for COBO L1 institution-owned, managed endpoints. COBO L1 represents the minimum acceptable assurance level for general-purpose institutional endpoint use.

import-profile.remarks: Imports institutional baseline security and governance requirements applicable to all managed endpoint systems.

system-characteristics.system-description: Institution-owned, centrally managed, general-purpose endpoint used for routine institutional academic and administrative activities. The endpoint is governed through its full lifecycle, configured to a standard security baseline, continuously evaluated for health and compliance, and protected against active threats at runtime.

props.name: ownership-model
props.remarks: Endpoint is owned by the institution.

props.name: management-model
props.remarks: Endpoint is centrally enrolled and governed.

props.name: assurance-model
props.remarks: Provides baseline assurance appropriate for general-purpose use.

props.name: eligible-data-classifications
props.remarks: Endpoint may participate in workflows involving Data Classification Levels 1 and 2, subject to policy and contextual controls.

props.name: non-equivalence-statement
props.remarks: Endpoint assurance level does not confer automatic entitlement to any data classification.

system-implementation.remarks: COBO L1 endpoints inherit all requirements from the Secure Endpoint composite pattern. This SSPP defines baseline expectations only and introduces no exceptions or elevated trust assumptions.

components.title: Endpoint Core
components.description: Endpoint identity, enrollment, classification, and baseline trust.

components.title: Endpoint Identity and Posture
components.description: Unique endpoint identity and posture signaling.

components.title: Endpoint Configuration and Hardening
components.description: Secure-by-default configuration, application control, and execution restrictions.

components.title: Endpoint Threat Protection
components.description: Runtime malware detection, behavioral protection, and local containment.

components.title: Endpoint Lifecycle
components.description: Managed endpoint provisioning, transition, recovery, and retirement.

roles.title: Endpoint Service Owner
roles.remarks: Accountable for endpoint classification, security standards, and lifecycle governance for COBO L1 endpoints.

props.name: nice-work-role
props.remarks: Executive Cyber Leadership per NIST NICE Framework (SP 800-181).

roles.title: Endpoint Operations
roles.remarks: Operates endpoint enrollment, configuration management, compliance enforcement, and protection services.

props.name: nice-work-role
props.remarks: Systems Administrator per NIST NICE Framework (SP 800-181).

roles.title: Endpoint Security Monitoring
roles.remarks: Monitors endpoint health, posture, compliance, and threat telemetry to support security operations and investigations.

props.name: nice-work-role
props.remarks: Security Operations Analyst per NIST NICE Framework (SP 800-181).

control-implementation.remarks: Controls are satisfied through inherited institutional baseline requirements and realization of all Secure Endpoint constituent patterns. COBO L1 introduces no compensating controls or risk acceptances.
